{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_figure.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Create figure with 8x8 inches at 120 dpi
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(8, 8), dpi=120, sharex='col', sharey='row')

# Data
x = [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]

# Top-left: y=x (blue solid line, circle markers, title "Linear")
axes[0, 0].plot(x, x, 'b-', marker='o', label='Linear')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Linear')
axes[0, 0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
axes[0, 0].legend(loc='upper left')

# Top-right: y=x**2 (red dashed line, square markers, title "Quadratic")
axes[0, 1].plot(x, [i**2 for i in x], 'r--', marker='s', label='Quadratic')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Quadratic')
axes[0, 1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
axes[0, 1].legend(loc='upper left')

# Bottom-left: y=x**3 (green dotted line, triangle markers, title "Cubic")
axes[1, 0].plot(x, [i**3 for i in x], 'g:', marker='^', label='Cubic')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Cubic')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
axes[1, 0].legend(loc='upper left')

# Bottom-right: y=abs(x) (purple dash-dot line, diamond markers, title "Absolute")
axes[1, 1].plot(x, [abs(i) for i in x], 'm-.', marker='D', label='Absolute')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Absolute')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
axes[1, 1].legend(loc='upper left')

# Set y-axis label for left-column panels
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('f(x)')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('f(x)')

# Set x-axis label for bottom-row panels
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('x')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('x')

# Set suptitle
fig.suptitle('Four Functions on a Shared Domain')

# Zero horizontal and vertical spacing between panels
plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=0, hspace=0)

# Hide top and right spines of every panel
for ax in axes.flat:
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
